A company is implementing shared storage for a gaming application hosted in an off-site data center. The company needs to access the data through a Lustre client, and the solution must be fully managed. Which solution meets these requirements?
Create an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Create a file share using the required client protocol. Connect the application servers to the file share.
Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure the Windows file sharing role on the instance. Connect the application servers to the file share.
Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system and configure Lustre support. Connect the file system to the original server. Connect the application servers to the file system.
Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Connect the file system to the original server. Connect the application servers to the file system.

A company has a web application with inconsistent usage patterns: high usage at the beginning of each month, moderate usage at the beginning of each week, and unpredictable usage on other weekdays. The application consists of web servers and a MySQL database server in a data center. The company wants to migrate the application to AWS and needs a cost-effective database platform that requires no database modifications. Which solution meets these requirements?
Amazon DynamoDB
Amazon RDS for MySQL
Amazon Aurora Serverless compatible with MySQL
MySQL deployed on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group

A company hires an external vendor to work in the company's AWS account. The vendor uses automation tools hosted in its own AWS account and does not have IAM access to the company's account. How should a solutions architect grant the vendor access?
Create an IAM role in the company's account that delegates access to the vendor's IAM role. Attach an appropriate IAM policy with the permissions the vendor needs.
Create an IAM user in the company's account with a password that meets complexity requirements. Attach an appropriate IAM policy with the permissions the vendor needs.
Create an IAM group in the company's account. Add the tool's IAM user from the vendor's account to the group. Attach an appropriate IAM policy with the permissions the vendor needs.

Create a new identity provider in the IAM console by selecting AWS account as the provider type. Supply the vendor's AWS account ID and user name. Attach an appropriate IAM policy with the permissions the vendor needs to the new provider.

A company runs an application for storing and sharing photos. Users upload approximately 150 photos each day to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants a solution that creates a thumbnail for each new photo and stores the thumbnails in a second S3 bucket. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

Configure an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke a script every minute on a running Amazon EMR cluster. Configure the script to generate thumbnails for photos without thumbnails and upload them to the second S3 bucket.

Configure an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke a script every minute on an always-on memory optimized Amazon EC2 instance. Configure the script to generate thumbnails for photos without thumbnails and upload them to the second S3 bucket.
Configure S3 event notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function whenever a user uploads a new photo. Configure the function to generate a thumbnail and upload it to the second S3 bucket.
Configure S3 Storage Lens to invoke an AWS Lambda function whenever a user uploads a new photo. Configure the function to generate a thumbnail and upload it to the second S3 bucket.

A company has an organization in AWS Organizations with all features enabled. The company requires auditing of API calls and sign-ins in all existing and new AWS accounts. The company needs a managed solution that avoids extra work and reduces costs. The company also needs to know when any AWS account does not comply with the AWS Foundational Security Best Practices (FSBP) standard. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Deploy an AWS Control Tower environment in the Organizations management account. Enable AWS Security Hub and AWS Control Tower Account Factory in the environment.
Deploy an AWS Control Tower environment in a dedicated Organizations member account. Enable AWS Security Hub and AWS Control Tower Account Factory in the environment.
Build a multi-account landing zone (MALZ) using AWS Managed Services (AMS) Accelerate. Submit a request for change (RFC) to self-provision Amazon GuardDuty in the MALZ.
Build a multi-account landing zone (MALZ) using AWS Managed Services (AMS) Accelerate. Submit a request for change (RFC) to self-provision AWS Security Hub in the MALZ.

A company is designing a web application on AWS. A VPN connection will link the company's existing data center and the application's VPC. The company uses Amazon Route 53 for DNS. The application must use private DNS records to communicate with on-premises services from the VPC. Which solution meets these requirements MOST securely?
Create a Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoint. Create a Resolver rule and associate it with the VPC.
Create a Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint. Create a Resolver rule and associate it with the VPC.
Create a Route 53 private hosted zone and associate it with the VPC.
Create a Route 53 public hosted zone. Create a record for each service to support communication.

A company has an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table for storage. A solutions architect finds that many requests to the table do not return the latest data. Users have not reported other database performance problems, and latency is acceptable. Which design change should the solutions architect recommend?
Add read replicas to the table.
Use a global secondary index (GSI).
Request strongly consistent reads from the table.
Request consistent reads from the table.

A company runs a containerized application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The application contains microservices for managing customers and placing orders. The company must route incoming requests to the appropriate microservice. Which solution meets this requirement MOST cost-effectively?
Use AWS Load Balancer Controller to provision a Network Load Balancer.
Use AWS Load Balancer Controller to provision an Application Load Balancer.
Use an AWS Lambda function to connect requests to Amazon EKS.
Use Amazon API Gateway to connect requests to Amazon EKS.

A company's application uses a Network Load Balancer, an Auto Scaling group, Amazon EC2 instances, and a database deployed in an Amazon VPC. The company wants to capture traffic information between network interfaces in the VPC in near real time and send it to Amazon OpenSearch Service for analysis. Which solution meets these requirements?
Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service.
Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service.
Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service.
Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service.

An online video game company must maintain ultra-low latency for game servers running on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs a solution that handles millions of requests per second of UDP internet traffic. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
Configure an Application Load Balancer with the required protocols and ports for internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as targets.
Configure a Gateway Load Balancer for internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as targets.
Configure a Network Load Balancer with the required protocols and ports for internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as targets.
Launch an identical set of game servers on EC2 instances in a different AWS Region. Route internet traffic to both sets of EC2 instances.

A company needs a solution that prevents photos containing unwanted content from being uploaded to its web application. The solution must not require training a machine learning (ML) model. Which solution meets these requirements?
Create and deploy a model with Amazon SageMaker Autopilot. Create a real-time endpoint that the web application invokes when a new photo is uploaded.
Create an AWS Lambda function that uses Amazon Rekognition to detect unwanted content. Create a function URL that the web application invokes when a new photo is uploaded.
Create a CloudFront function that uses Amazon Comprehend to detect unwanted content. Associate the function with the web application.
Create an AWS Lambda function that uses Amazon Rekognition Video to detect unwanted content. Create a function URL that the web application invokes when a new photo is uploaded.

A company runs its ecommerce platform on AWS. The platform is critical to business operations and handles high traffic and transaction volumes. The company has configured a multi-factor authentication (MFA) device to protect its AWS account root user credentials. The company wants to ensure that losing the MFA device does not cause it to lose access to the root user account. Which solution meets these requirements?
Set up a backup administrator account to sign in if the company loses its MFA device.
Add multiple MFA devices to the root user account for disaster scenarios.
Create a new administrator account when the company loses access to the root account.
Attach an administrator policy to another IAM user when the company loses access to the root account.

A company runs workloads on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Container images used in ECS task definitions must be scanned for common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVEs). Newly created images must also be scanned. Which solution meets these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the workloads?
Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private repository for container images. Specify scan-on-push filters for ECR basic scanning.
Store container images in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to scan the images. Configure S3 event notifications to start a Macie scan for each s3:ObjectCreated:Put event.

Deploy the workloads on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository. Specify scan-on-push filters for ECR enhanced scanning.

Store container images in a versioned Amazon S3 bucket. Configure S3 event notifications for s3:ObjectCreated:* events to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the function to start an Amazon Inspector scan.

An ecommerce company is migrating its on-premises workloads to AWS. The workloads include a web application and a backend Microsoft SQL database. The company expects large numbers of customers during promotional events. The new AWS infrastructure must be highly available and scalable. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

Migrate the web application to two Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server with read replicas in two Availability Zones.

Migrate the web application to Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group spanning two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to two EC2 instances in different AWS Regions with database replication.
Migrate the web application to Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to Amazon RDS with a Multi-AZ deployment.

Migrate the web application to three Amazon EC2 instances across three Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to three EC2 instances across three Availability Zones.

A company runs a critical storage application in the AWS Cloud using Amazon S3 in two AWS Regions. The company wants the application to send remote users' data to the closest S3 bucket without public network congestion. The application must also fail over with minimal management overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?
Implement an active-active design across the two Regions. Configure the application to use the Regional S3 endpoint closest to each user.
Use S3 Multi-Region Access Points in an active-passive configuration. Create a global endpoint for each Region.
Send user data to the Regional S3 endpoint closest to the user. Configure an S3 cross-account replication rule to synchronize the buckets.
Configure Amazon S3 to use Multi-Region Access Points in an active-active configuration with a single global endpoint. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication.

A company hosts a website on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The website serves static content, and traffic is increasing. The company wants to minimize hosting costs. Which solution meets these requirements?
Migrate the website to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the bucket.
Migrate the website to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon ElastiCache cluster for the bucket.
Migrate the website to AWS Amplify. Configure an ALB to resolve to the Amplify website.
Migrate the website to AWS Amplify. Configure EC2 instances to cache the website.

A company is migrating its workloads to AWS. Sensitive and critical data is stored in an on-premises relational database running on SQL Server. The company wants to use AWS to improve security and reduce database operational overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?
Migrate the database to an Amazon EC2 instance. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) managed keys for encryption.
Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for SQL Server Multi-AZ DB instance. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) managed keys for encryption.
Migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to secure the data.
Migrate the database to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to secure the data.

A company runs database workloads on AWS as the backend for its customer portal. The company uses an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Multi-AZ DB cluster and needs a 30-day backup retention policy. The company currently has both automated and manual RDS backups and wants to retain all existing backups of either type that are less than 30 days old. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
Use AWS Backup to set a 30-day RDS retention policy for automated backups. Manually delete manual backups older than 30 days.
Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated and manual backups older than 30 days. Set the RDS retention policy to 30 days for automated backups.
Set the RDS retention policy to 30 days for automated backups. Manually delete manual backups older than 30 days.
Disable RDS automated backups. Use AWS CloudFormation to automatically delete automated and manual backups older than 30 days. Set the RDS retention policy to 30 days for automated backups.

A company's expense tracking application lets users upload receipt images. The application analyzes receipts to extract information and stores the original images in Amazon S3. It is written in Java and runs on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. Compute and storage costs are growing as the application becomes more popular. Which solution provides the MOST cost savings without affecting application performance?
Purchase a Compute Savings Plan covering the maximum number of EC2 instances. Store uploaded files in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS).
Reduce the minimum number of EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group. Use On-Demand Instances for peak scaling. Store uploaded files in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS).
Reduce the maximum number of EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group. Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to archive original images to a lower-cost storage tier after 30 days.

Purchase a Compute Savings Plan covering the minimum required number of EC2 instances. Use On-Demand Instances for peak scaling. Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to archive original images to a lower-cost storage tier after 30 days.

A company needs a resilient web application to process customer orders. The application must automatically handle increases in web traffic and usage without affecting the customer experience or losing customer orders. Which solution meets these requirements?

Use a NAT gateway to manage web traffic. Use an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to receive, process, and store processed customer orders. Use an AWS Lambda function to capture and store unprocessed orders.

Use a Network Load Balancer (NLB) to manage web traffic. Use an Application Load Balancer to receive customer orders from the NLB. Use Amazon Redshift with a Multi-AZ deployment to store unprocessed orders and orders being processed.

Use a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) to manage web traffic. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to receive and process customer orders. Use the GWLB to capture and store unprocessed orders. Use Amazon DynamoDB to store processed orders.

Use an Application Load Balancer to manage web traffic. Use an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to receive and process customer orders. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to store unprocessed orders. Use Amazon RDS with a Multi-AZ deployment to store processed orders.
